speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: are the leg pains severe enough to prevent you from walking, and have you noticed any joint swelling or warmth in the affected areas? Also, have you had any recent infections or been exposed to sick contacts recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL). REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential, Peripheral Smear. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Abdomen and Pelvis.
